note: Headers exclude date, content-length, connection and transfer-encoding, which net/http adds for framing; names are lower-cased and values of the trailer header sorted, because grpc-gateway announces trailers in Go map order. protojson inserts a random space after each comma, chosen per binary (internal/detrand); bodies are recorded without it. The two fallback bodies are constants in runtime/errors.go and are recorded byte for byte.
